name: Science – PCM
one_line_description: Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics pathway focusing on engineering, physical sciences, computing, architecture, and technical branches.
cost_range_note: Ranges from medium (government science degree programs) to high (private engineering colleges)

name: Science – PCB
one_line_description: Physics, Chemistry, and Biology pathway leading to medical, dental, allied health sciences, pharmacy, biotechnology, and agricultural careers.
cost_range_note: Ranges from low (government B.Sc colleges) to very high (private medical and dental colleges)

name: Science – PCMB
one_line_description: Four-subject core Science track keeping both engineering/tech and medical/bio-sciences pathways simultaneously open.
cost_range_note: Ranges from low (central/state universities) to high (private professional institutes across Engg/Med)

name: Commerce (with Maths)
one_line_description: Commerce, Accounting, Business Studies and Mathematics track tailored for finance, CA/CS, actuarial science, economics, and analytics.
cost_range_note: Ranges from medium (public university B.Com/Economics) to high (private professional courses & B-Schools)

name: Commerce (without Maths)
one_line_description: Commerce and Business Management track focusing on general accounting, business administration, hospitality, marketing, and media.
cost_range_note: Ranges from low (government B.Com colleges) to high (private hotel management and business institutes)

name: Humanities / Arts
one_line_description: Interdisciplinary exploration of history, political science, psychology, sociology, literature, law, public administration, and design.
cost_range_note: Ranges from low (central and state public B.A. universities) to high (private liberal arts and design schools)

name: Diploma / Polytechnic
one_line_description: Direct 3-year technical applied engineering education starting immediately after Class 10 with lateral entry into 2nd year B.Tech.
cost_range_note: Generally low to moderate (heavily subsidized in state government polytechnic colleges)

name: ITI (Industrial Training)
one_line_description: 1 to 2-year practical vocational skill certification (NCVT/SCVT) preparing students directly for skilled industry employment or apprenticeship.
cost_range_note: Generally very low or free (government-funded vocational training institutes with nominal examination fees)

name: Science – Computer Science Group
one_line_description: Physics, Mathematics and Computer Science (with Chemistry in PCM+CS combinations) pathway leading to software, AI/ML, data science, cybersecurity, and IT careers.
cost_range_note: Ranges from low (government B.Sc CS/BCA programs) to high (private B.E./B.Tech CSE colleges)

name: Vocational Stream (HSC Vocational / NSQF)
one_line_description: Class 11-12 skill-based stream combining core subjects with job-oriented trades in engineering technology, agriculture, business, health care, and home science.
cost_range_note: Generally low (government and government-aided schools with nominal fees)

name: Commerce with Computer Applications / Informatics Practices
one_line_description: Commerce, Accounting and Business Studies combined with Computer Applications or Informatics Practices for business analytics, fintech, e-commerce, and IT-enabled services.
cost_range_note: Ranges from low (government B.Com CA/BBA colleges) to high (private B-Schools and analytics programs)

name: Arts, Design, Sports & Performing Arts
one_line_description: Creative and performance pathway covering fine arts, design (NID/NIFT/UCEED routes), physical education and sports science, music, dance, and film/media.
cost_range_note: Ranges from low (government arts colleges) to very high (private design and film institutes)

name: B.Tech – Computer Science Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/CS)
eligibility.min_marks_note: Typically 45–50% in 10+2 (75% aggregate or top-20 percentile for NITs/IITs via JEE Main)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, JEE Advanced, State Engineering CETs (e.g. MHT CET, KCET, WBJEE), BITSAT
eligibility.age_limit: 17–25 years (relaxation applies as per exam rules)

typical_qualification: B.Tech / B.E. (Bachelor of Technology in CSE)
reversibility_note: Highly specialized technical curriculum; pivoting to non-technical fields later requires postgraduate study or independent portfolio building.

name: B.Tech – Electronics & Communication Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry)
eligibility.min_marks_note: 50% in PCM aggregate (relaxation for reserved categories)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, State CETs

reversibility_note: Rigorous hardware and signal processing training makes late shifts challenging.

name: B.Tech – Electrical Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (PCM)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, State CETs

reversibility_note: Heavy focus on core circuit theory and power grids; switching requires substantial retraining.

name: B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (PCM)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, State CETs

reversibility_note: Deep engineering foundation; provides strong quantitative skills but difficult to pivot to life sciences or medicine.

name: B.Tech – Civil Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (PCM)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, State CETs

reversibility_note: Specialized in structural design and site construction; career track is distinct.

name: B.Arch – Architecture

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (PCM) or 10+3 Diploma with Mathematics
eligibility.min_marks_note: 50% in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and 50% in aggregate
eligibility.entrance_exam: NATA (National Aptitude Test in Architecture) or JEE Main Paper 2

reversibility_note: Design and spatial fundamentals allow branching into interior design, product design, or urban planning.

name: B.Sc – Data Science & Computing

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (with Mathematics / Statistics)
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG or Institute CET

reversibility_note: Solid grounding in mathematics, statistics, and coding allows seamless transitions into analytics, software, or business roles.
non_degree_alt: Certificate Bootcamp in Python & Data Analytics

name: B.Sc – Physics (Honours / Research)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG, NEST (for NISER), IAT (for IISERs)

reversibility_note: Pure science graduates can easily transition into tech, teaching, data analysis, or civil services.

name: Commercial Pilot License (CPL)

eligibility.stream_required: 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (or NIOS equivalent)
eligibility.min_marks_note: Pass in 10+2 with Physics and Maths; Class 1 Medical Clearance (DGCA)
eligibility.entrance_exam: Cadet Pilot Selection / Flying Club Entrance & DGCA Medical
eligibility.age_limit: Minimum 17 years to begin flying training

duration: 18 to 24 months (200 hours flying + ground theory exams)
typical_qualification: Commercial Pilot License (DGCA CPL with Multi-Engine Instrument Rating)
reversibility_note: Substantial financial investment and dedicated flight logs make it difficult to discard without heavy cost.

name: Merchant Navy (B.Sc Nautical Science / Marine Engg)

eligibility.stream_required: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics
eligibility.min_marks_note: 60% aggregate in PCM and 50% in English in 10th or 12th; 6/6 eye sight without colour blindness
eligibility.entrance_exam: IMU-CET (Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test)

typical_qualification: B.Sc Nautical Science (Deck Officer) / B.Tech Marine Engg
reversibility_note: Sea service commitments and specialised maritime training lock in the nautical career path.

name: MBBS – Medicine & Surgery

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotech, and English
eligibility.min_marks_note: 50% aggregate in PCB for General; 40% for SC/ST/OBC; must qualify NEET-UG cutoff percentile
eligibility.entrance_exam: NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test)
eligibility.age_limit: Completed 17 years by Dec 31 of admission year; no upper age limit

duration: 5.5 years (4.5 years academic + 1 year compulsory rotatory internship)
reversibility_note: Extensive 5.5-year commitment and rural service bond make mid-stream career switches practically impossible.

name: BDS – Dental Surgery

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCB and English
eligibility.min_marks_note: 50% in PCB for General category; 40% for reserved categories
eligibility.entrance_exam: NEET-UG
eligibility.age_limit: Completed 17 years by Dec 31 of admission year

typical_qualification: BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery - DCI registered)
reversibility_note: Specialized clinical hand skills; switching requires enrolling in a fresh undergraduate program.

name: BAMS – Ayurvedic Medicine & Surgery

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCB and English (Sanskrit knowledge helpful)
eligibility.entrance_exam: NEET-UG (AYUSH Counseling via AACCC)

reversibility_note: Ayurvedic pharmacology and classical clinical curriculum are highly distinct.

name: BHMS – Homeopathic Medicine & Surgery

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCB
eligibility.entrance_exam: NEET-UG

reversibility_note: Specialized system of medicine; late redirection requires starting fresh.

name: B.Pharm – Pharmacy

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCM or PCB
eligibility.entrance_exam: State Pharmacy CETs, MHT-CET, WBJEE, KCET, NEET (in select states)

reversibility_note: Pharmacy curriculum provides broad chemical, biological, and analytical training; transitions to healthcare management, clinical trials, or MBA are common.

name: B.Sc – Nursing

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English
eligibility.entrance_exam: NEET-UG (for military & central institutes), State Nursing CETs, AIIMS B.Sc Nursing Exam

reversibility_note: Heavy hands-on patient clinical care training; pivot to non-healthcare fields requires independent study.

name: BPT – Physiotherapy

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCB
eligibility.entrance_exam: NEET-UG or State Paramedical CETs

reversibility_note: Clinical physical therapy training is highly specialized.

name: B.Sc (Hons) – Agriculture

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCB, PCM, or Agriculture
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG (ICAR-AIEEA quota) or State Agricultural University CETs

duration: 4 years (8 semesters with RAWE field work)
reversibility_note: Comprehensive applied biological and economic curriculum makes pivoting to agribusiness, banking, or civil services very feasible.

name: B.Sc – Biotechnology

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCB or PCM
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG, University Entrance

reversibility_note: Strong lab and molecular biology foundation; enables movement into life sciences research, bioinformatics, or pharmaceutical sales.

name: B.V.Sc & AH – Veterinary Science & Animal Husbandry

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English
eligibility.entrance_exam: NEET-UG (for VCI 15% All India quota) and State Veterinary CETs

reversibility_note: Extensive animal anatomy and surgical training is highly specific.

name: B.Tech – Biomedical Engineering & Medical Devices

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCMB or PCM with Biology
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, State CETs, BITSAT, VITEEE

typical_qualification: B.Tech in Biomedical Engineering (AICTE / UGC approved)
reversibility_note: Interdisciplinary engineering foundation allows movement into healthtech, software devices, medical robotics, or computational biology.

name: B.Tech – Biotechnology & Bioinformatics

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCMB, PCM, or PCB
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, CUET-UG, State Engineering CETs

reversibility_note: Combines molecular biology, chemistry, and algorithms; versatile across pharmaceuticals, data science, and bioscience patents.

name: B.Tech – Agricultural & Biosystems Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCMB or PCM
eligibility.entrance_exam: ICAR AIEEA (via CUET-UG), JEE Main, State CETs

reversibility_note: Integrates mechanical systems, sensors, hydrology, and plant biology with high demand in modern agritech and green energy.

name: B.Tech – Food Technology & Processing Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCMB, PCM, or PCB
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG (CFTRI / NIFTEM), JEE Main, State CETs

reversibility_note: Strong chemical, microbiological, and industrial manufacturing training with direct openings in FMCG giants and government regulatory bodies.

name: B.Sc (Hons) – Biophysics & Computational Biology

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Maths & Biology)
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG, IISER IAT, NEST

reversibility_note: Deep quantitative and physical modeling of biological systems; highly sought after in modern structural genomics and AI drug design.

name: Chartered Accountancy (CA)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Any Stream, Commerce with Maths recommended)
eligibility.min_marks_note: Pass in 10+2 from recognized board for CA Foundation; no minimum percentage threshold
eligibility.entrance_exam: CA Foundation (held twice a year by ICAI) or Direct Entry for Commerce Graduates with 55%

duration: Typically 3.5 to 5 years (Foundation + Intermediate + 2-year practical articleship + CA Final)
typical_qualification: FCA / ACA (Member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India)
reversibility_note: Articleship provides deep real-world financial audit exposure; CA students can easily pivot to B.Com, MBA Finance, or corporate roles.

name: Company Secretary (CS)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream (except Fine Arts)
eligibility.entrance_exam: CSEET (Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test) conducted by ICSI

duration: 3 to 4 years (CSEET + Executive + Professional + 21 months practical training)
reversibility_note: Corporate law and governance expertise allows smooth pairing with LLB or corporate compliance roles.

name: CMA – Cost and Management Accountancy

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream
eligibility.entrance_exam: CMA Foundation (ICMAI)

duration: 3 to 4 years (Foundation + Intermediate + Final + 15 months practical training)
typical_qualification: ACMA (Associate Cost and Management Accountant - ICMAI)
reversibility_note: Cost accounting and industrial budgeting focus provides solid corporate finance skills.

name: B.Com (Honours)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 Commerce with Mathematics / Accountancy
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG (for central universities like Delhi University) or Merit

reversibility_note: Versatile foundational commerce degree; enables entry into banking, civil services, MBA, or entrepreneurship.

name: B.Sc – Actuarial Science

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 with Mathematics / Statistics (minimum 70% in Maths recommended)
eligibility.min_marks_note: 60% aggregate in 10+2 with high Mathematics score
eligibility.entrance_exam: ACET (Actuarial Common Entrance Test) via IAI, CUET-UG

duration: 3 years (degree) + ongoing actuarial professional paper clearances (IAI / IFoA)
typical_qualification: B.Sc Actuarial Science + Qualified Actuary credential
reversibility_note: High-level probability and statistical modeling skills are highly prized across data science and quantitative finance.

name: B.Com (General / Program)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in Commerce or any stream
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG or Merit-based admission

reversibility_note: Broad commerce overview; highly flexible for government exams, marketing, banking, and family businesses.

name: BHM – Hotel & Hospitality Administration

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream with English as a subject
eligibility.entrance_exam: NCHMCT-JEE (National Council for Hotel Management & Catering Technology Joint Entrance Exam)
eligibility.age_limit: 25 years for General/OBC; 28 years for SC/ST

reversibility_note: Strong hospitality operations and customer service training allow shifts to luxury retail, aviation, or customer success.
non_degree_alt: Diploma in Food Production / Bakery (1.5 Years)

name: BA – Journalism & Mass Communication (BJMC)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG, IIMC Entrance Exam, IPU CET, Xavier Entrance

reversibility_note: Communication and digital content production skills translate across PR, advertising, branding, and corporate communications.

name: BBA / B.Sc – Travel & Tourism Management

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG / University Entrance Exam

reversibility_note: General business and logistics background makes lateral shifts into hospitality, event planning, or retail straightforward.

name: Integrated BA / BBA LL.B (5-Year Law)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream
eligibility.min_marks_note: 45% in 10+2 for General category (40% for SC/ST)
eligibility.entrance_exam: CLAT (Common Law Admission Test for NLUs), AILET (NLU Delhi), LSAT-India, SLAT
eligibility.age_limit: No upper age limit (Supreme Court judgment)

typical_qualification: BA LL.B (Hons) / BBA LL.B (Hons) - Bar Council of India registered
reversibility_note: Intensive 5-year legal jurisprudence and court advocacy training; leaves little room for parallel technical careers.

name: Civil Services (IAS / IPS / IFS Preparation Pathway)

eligibility.stream_required: Any Bachelor's Degree (BA, B.Com, B.Sc, B.Tech, MBBS)
eligibility.min_marks_note: Graduation degree from recognized university (no minimum graduation percentage required)
eligibility.entrance_exam: UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims + Mains + Personality Test)
eligibility.age_limit: 21 to 32 years for General (35 for OBC, 37 for SC/ST)

duration: 3 years undergraduate degree + 1 to 2 years rigorous competitive preparation
typical_qualification: Any Bachelor's Degree + UPSC Civil Services Appointment
reversibility_note: Broad general knowledge and analytical thinking preparation helps significantly in state PSCs, teaching, think-tanks, and public policy.

name: BA / B.Sc – Psychology

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream (Humanities or Science preferred)
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG or University Merit

reversibility_note: Human behavior, cognitive science, and research methodology fundamentals allow pivoting into HR, UX research, marketing, or counseling.

name: BFA – Bachelor of Fine Arts (Painting / Applied Art)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream
eligibility.entrance_exam: College Practical Aptitude Test & Drawing Portfolio Review

reversibility_note: Foundational visual design and composition skills translate well into digital illustration, graphic design, and UI/UX.
non_degree_alt: Diploma in Fine Arts / Commercial Art

name: B.Des – Fashion / Product / Communication Design

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 in any stream
eligibility.entrance_exam: UCEED (IIT Bombay), NID DAT (National Institute of Design), NIFT Entrance Exam

reversibility_note: Design thinking and problem-solving skills allow movement across industrial, digital, fashion, and interaction design domains.

name: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass with Science and Mathematics
eligibility.min_marks_note: Typically 35–45% aggregate in Class 10 (varies by state DTE)
eligibility.entrance_exam: State Polytechnic CET (e.g. JEECUP, POLYCET, JEXPO, Delhi CET)
eligibility.age_limit: Minimum 14 to 15 years; no strict upper age limit

typical_qualification: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (State Board of Technical Education)
reversibility_note: Most Indian states offer Lateral Entry into 2nd year B.Tech Mechanical Engineering, making academic upgrade seamless.

name: Diploma in Civil Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass with Science and Maths
eligibility.entrance_exam: State Polytechnic Entrance Exam

reversibility_note: Eligible for Lateral Entry B.Tech 2nd year in Civil Engineering across government and private engineering colleges.

name: Diploma in Electrical Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass with Science and Maths
eligibility.entrance_exam: State Polytechnic CET

reversibility_note: Direct lateral entry available into 2nd year B.Tech Electrical Engineering.

name: Diploma in Computer Engineering / IT

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass with Science and Maths
eligibility.entrance_exam: State Polytechnic CET

reversibility_note: Provides lateral entry into 2nd year B.Tech CSE / IT.

name: Diploma in Automobile Engineering

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass with Science and Mathematics
eligibility.min_marks_note: Typically 35–45% aggregate in Class 10 (varies by state DTE)
eligibility.entrance_exam: State Polytechnic CET (e.g. JEECUP, POLYCET, JEXPO, Delhi CET)
eligibility.age_limit: Minimum 14 to 15 years; no strict upper age limit

typical_qualification: Diploma in Automobile Engineering (State Board of Technical Education / AICTE)
reversibility_note: Direct Lateral Entry into 2nd year B.Tech Automobile / Mechanical Engineering across top engineering institutions.

name: ITI – Electrician (Trade Certificate)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass with Science and Mathematics
eligibility.entrance_exam: State ITI Merit Counseling (DGT / NCVT portal)
eligibility.age_limit: Minimum 14 years; no upper age limit

typical_qualification: National Trade Certificate (NTC) in Electrician Trade (NCVT/DGT recognized)
reversibility_note: Short vocational certificate; students can easily pursue higher polytechnic diploma (with 2nd year lateral entry in some states) or take 10+2 exams via NIOS.

name: ITI – Fitter (Mechanical Assembly)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass with Science and Maths
eligibility.entrance_exam: State ITI Admission / Merit

typical_qualification: National Trade Certificate in Fitter Trade
reversibility_note: Hands-on mechanical training; can progress into a Polytechnic Mechanical Diploma via lateral admission.

name: ITI – Welder (Gas & Electric)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 8 or Class 10 pass
eligibility.entrance_exam: Merit-based state admission

typical_qualification: NTC in Welder Trade (Structural / Pipe / TIG-MIG)
reversibility_note: Quick 1-year skill certification with high immediate domestic and international demand; minimal obstacle to switching.

name: ITI – COPA (Computer Operator & Programming Assistant)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass
eligibility.entrance_exam: State ITI Counseling

reversibility_note: Basic computer literacy and office automation certification; very easy to pursue higher degrees alongside.

name: ITI – Mechanic (Motor Vehicle / Diesel)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 10 pass with Science and Mathematics
eligibility.entrance_exam: State ITI Admission

reversibility_note: Practical vehicle repair skill; eligible for lateral advancement into Automobile Engineering Diploma.

name: National Defence Academy (NDA & Naval Academy)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 Pass — Any Stream for Army Wing; Physics & Maths (PCM) for Air Force and Navy Wings
eligibility.min_marks_note: Pass in 10+2 from recognized board; strict physical & medical fitness standards (SSB Interview)
eligibility.entrance_exam: NDA & NA Examination (UPSC) conducted twice a year + 5-Day SSB Interview & Medical Board

duration: 3 years at NDA (Khadakwasla) followed by 1 year at IMA / AFA / INA
typical_qualification: Commissioned Officer (Lieutenant / Sub-Lieutenant / Flying Officer rank) + Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) BA / B.Sc / B.Tech degree
reversibility_note: Once commissioned into the Indian Armed Forces, terms of service and military discipline govern the career; resigning commission involves formal government release.

name: State Police & Central Armed Police Forces (SI / Inspector Entry)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 Pass for Constable / Tradesman; Any Bachelor's Degree for Sub-Inspector (SI)
eligibility.min_marks_note: Pass in qualifying exam; must pass physical measurement (PST) and physical endurance test (PET - running, long jump)
eligibility.entrance_exam: SSC CPO (Central Police Organization) for Delhi Police/CAPFs or State Police Recruitment Board SI Exams
eligibility.age_limit: 20 to 25 years for SI (relaxation for reserved categories)

duration: 3 years degree + 1-year police academy basic training
typical_qualification: Sub-Inspector of Police (Group-B Non-Gazetted Executive Officer)
reversibility_note: Uniformed executive enforcement service with statutory powers; switching out requires resignation from government service.

name: Civil Services – IAS / IPS / IFS (Any Stream)

eligibility.stream_required: Any Bachelor's Degree (BA, B.Sc, B.Com, B.Tech, MBBS, BBA, Law, etc.)
eligibility.min_marks_note: Simple pass in Graduation from any UGC-recognized central, state, or private university
eligibility.entrance_exam: UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims + Mains + Interview)
eligibility.age_limit: 21 to 32 years (35 for OBC, 37 for SC/ST)

typical_qualification: IAS / IPS / IFS / IRS Group-A Officer
reversibility_note: Comprehensive general studies and administrative curriculum provides strong foundation for public policy, state administrative exams, think tanks, and banking.

name: Banking & Financial Services (IBPS / SBI PO & Clerk)

eligibility.stream_required: Any Bachelor's Degree in any discipline
eligibility.entrance_exam: IBPS PO / Clerk, SBI PO / Clerk, RBI Grade B Exam

duration: 3 years degree + 6–12 months competitive test preparation
typical_qualification: Probationary Officer (Scale-I) / Junior Associate in Public Sector Bank
reversibility_note: Banking, credit appraisal, and risk management knowledge is transferable to private banks, NBFCs, and fintech companies.

name: Staff Selection Commission (SSC CGL) & Indian Railways (RRB NTPC)

eligibility.stream_required: Any Bachelor's Degree (Class 12 for CHSL and RRB Level 2/3 posts)
eligibility.entrance_exam: SSC CGL / SSC CHSL / RRB NTPC (Non-Technical Popular Categories)

typical_qualification: Assistant Section Officer (Central Ministries) / Station Master / Inspector of Income Tax & GST
reversibility_note: Central government executive roles offer permanent tenure and statutory responsibilities.
non_degree_alt: SSC CHSL (after Class 12) / RRB Group D (after 10th/ITI)

name: B.E./B.Tech CSE & IT

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Physics, Mathematics, and CS/Chemistry)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, JEE Advanced, State CETs, BITSAT, VITEEE

reversibility_note: Strong foundation in software engineering enables pivoting into tech product management, data science, fintech, or systems architecture.
cost_range_note: Ranges from ₹2L-₹8L total in government/state colleges to ₹12L-₹25L in private universities.
non_degree_alt: Full-stack developer bootcamps + AWS/GCP certifications + GitHub portfolio

name: AI & Data Science

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Physics, Mathematics, and CS/Chemistry)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, State CETs, University Entrance Tests

typical_qualification: B.Tech / B.Sc in AI & Data Science
reversibility_note: Specialized math and computing skills apply directly across tech, healthcare analytics, quant finance, and robotics.
cost_range_note: Ranges from ₹1.5L in state universities to ₹16L+ in premier private engineering institutes.
non_degree_alt: Kaggle Grandmaster track + TensorFlow / DeepLearning.AI credentials

name: Cybersecurity

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Physics, Mathematics, and CS/Chemistry)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, State CETs, CUET

typical_qualification: B.Tech / B.Sc in Cybersecurity & Digital Forensics
reversibility_note: High industry demand across defense, banking, cloud service providers, and critical national infrastructure.
cost_range_note: Moderate in central/state universities (₹1L-₹4L), high in specialized private institutes (₹8L-₹18L).
non_degree_alt: CompTIA Security+, CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), OSCP certifications

name: B.Sc Computer Science

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Mathematics + CS/Physics/Chemistry)
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG, State University Merit / CET

reversibility_note: Broad theoretical foundation facilitates post-grad entry into MCA, Data Science, or MBA.
cost_range_note: Very low to low in government/aided colleges (₹15,000 - ₹80,000 total).
non_degree_alt: Open-source software projects + competitive coding profile (LeetCode/Codeforces)

name: BCA

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Mathematics or CS preferred in most universities)
eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET, IPU CET, State CETs

reversibility_note: High flexibility to pursue higher technical degrees or join corporate IT delivery teams directly.
cost_range_note: Low in government colleges (₹20,000-₹60,000) to moderate in private colleges (₹1.5L-₹4.5L).
non_degree_alt: Front-end / Back-end specialization bootcamps and live freelance client delivery

name: Integrated M.Tech/MCA

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Physics, Mathematics, CS/Chemistry)
eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main, University Direct Entrance Tests, CUET

typical_qualification: Integrated M.Tech / MCA in Computing & Software Systems
reversibility_note: Seamless 5-year accelerated path saving one academic year compared to separate B.Tech + M.Tech.
cost_range_note: Ranges from moderate in Central Universities to high in private autonomous universities.

name: Game Development & Design Tech

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 (Mathematics/CS preferred)
eligibility.entrance_exam: University Portfolio/Aptitude Test, CUET

typical_qualification: B.Sc / B.Tech in Game Programming & Interactive Media
reversibility_note: Strong 3D graphics and C#/C++ foundation applies directly to AR/VR, simulation, VFX, and metaverse apps.
cost_range_note: Moderate to high in specialized multimedia and technical design universities (₹3L-₹12L).
non_degree_alt: Unity Certified Associate / Unreal Engine Fellowship + itch.io indie game releases

name: Vocational B.Voc degrees

eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG / University Merit

duration: 3 years with multiple exit points (Diploma 1yr, Adv Diploma 2yr, B.Voc 3yr)
reversibility_note: Multiple exit options (Certificate, Diploma, Advanced Diploma, Degree) provide maximum career agility.
cost_range_note: Low (₹10,000 - ₹50,000 per year in UGC/NSQF funded institutions).
non_degree_alt: NSDC Sector Skill Council Level 5/6 specialized certifications

name: Lateral entry to Diploma/B.Tech (where eligible)

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 Vocational / Technical HSC stream with relevant trade
eligibility.entrance_exam: State Lateral Entry Entrance Test (LEET / VOC CET)

duration: 2 years for Diploma (Direct 2nd yr) or 3 years for B.Tech (Direct 2nd yr)
reversibility_note: Seamless vertical academic ladder from vocational school directly into mainstream engineering.
cost_range_note: Subsidized government polytechnics and state engineering colleges (₹20,000-₹80,000/yr).

name: Skilled employment

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 Vocational Certificate / NSQF Level 4 Qualification
eligibility.entrance_exam: Direct recruitment / Skill assessment

duration: Immediate job placement upon completion of 12th
typical_qualification: Certified Industry Technician / Associate / Healthcare Assistant
reversibility_note: Immediate earnings and industry exposure with freedom to pursue distance or evening degrees.
cost_range_note: Zero tuition; starts earning entry-level salaries immediately (₹1.8L - ₹3.5L/year).

name: Apprenticeships

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 Vocational / NSQF Certificate
eligibility.entrance_exam: NAPS Portal Enrollment

duration: 1 to 2 years structured on-the-job training with stipend
reversibility_note: Government-recognized certification that qualifies for reserved technical vacancies in Indian Railways and PSUs.
cost_range_note: Free training with monthly government-mandated stipend (₹7,000 - ₹12,000/month).

name: Self-employment

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 Vocational trade knowledge
eligibility.entrance_exam: None (PMEGP / Mudra Loan eligible)

typical_qualification: Micro-Enterprise Owner / Contractor / Certified Freelance Specialist
reversibility_note: Independent entrepreneurial ownership with complete control over services and business scale.
cost_range_note: Initial setup capital supported by Mudra / PMEGP government credit schemes.

eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG / State University Merit

name: Business Analytics & Data Management

eligibility.stream_required: Class 12 Commerce with IP / Maths
eligibility.entrance_exam: University CET / CUET

reversibility_note: Analytical skills in SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, and Python provide high portability across all business sectors.

eligibility.entrance_exam: CUET-UG, State CETs

eligibility.entrance_exam: Direct Merit / University Test

name: Bachelor of Design (B.Des – NID / UCEED / Private)

eligibility.entrance_exam: UCEED (IIT Bombay), NID DAT, NIFT, SEED

eligibility.entrance_exam: NIFT Entrance Exam (CAT + GAT + Situation Test)
